title: Round 2: choose the visual world for Soni Khimraj Lalji Jewellers
question: Your shortlist stays on the table: the Kankotri and the category standard. The re-roll adds The Wall Calendar and my pick, The Velvet Counter. Choose one, or steer.

options.label: The Wall Calendar
options.lineage: Mumbai household panchang wall calendars, with festivals and auspicious days marked
options.thesis: The site is the calendar by the kitchen: today's cell holds today's gold rate, auspicious days for buying gold are flagged, and the back of each leaf carries the shop's notes.
options.viewport: A giant month leaf with the name in Devanagari as the masthead, today's cell boxed in red holding the IBJA rate, muhurat flags, a jewellery photo panel and WhatsApp Mr. Soni.
options.risk: Calendar grids can turn dense and dry, and festival dates must be checked every year. The mockup's Christmas baubles are an AI error and would be removed.

raised.raise: Time is real: today's cell, 'Open now · closes 9:30 PM', and the IBJA date all come from the live clock and rate.
Every piece caption is a stitched label of facts: karat, hallmark, approximate weight and occasion.
The rate sits in fixed tabular cells; only changed digits flip, like a jeweller's LED rate board.
Palette law: festival red marks only today and auspicious days; nothing else may use it.
Collection pieces turn over like calendar leaves to show their facts on the back.
Four inks only: paper white, black, festival red, and leaf green for the WhatsApp action.

options.label: The Velvet Counter
options.lineage: the jeweller's glass counter: bottle-green velvet trays, touchstone, loupe and scale
options.thesis: The site is the counter you sit at: pieces on velvet trays, purity tested on the touchstone in front of you, the weight read off the scale.
options.viewport: An overhead counter photo: a velvet tray with a kundan necklace and bangles, the touchstone streak and scale beside it, 'Tested in front of you. Weighed in front of you.' with WhatsApp Mr. Soni.
options.risk: Dark velvet can slide toward generic dark-luxury; it stays specific only through the touchstone, scale and real counter tools, and it needs strong photography.

options.label: The Kankotri
options.lineage: Gujarati and Marathi wedding invitation cards (kankotri, lagna patrika)
options.thesis: The site reads like a family's wedding invitation: layered cards, the shop's blessing line, foil borders, and the visit to Jivdaya Lane as the venue block.
options.viewport: An invitation opens: the blessing line, the name in Devanagari foil, 'You're invited to Jivdaya Lane' with the address and hours as the venue, and RSVP on WhatsApp.
options.risk: Familiar for Indian bridal sites, and it can feel wedding-only for daily wear and old-gold visitors.

options.label: Rain-night cityscape
options.thesis: A city passing from blue hour into rain-dark night.
options.risk: Moody and dark; it hides the gold and the rate.
options.case: Loses on both axes: families don't buy gold through a night-city mood, and it obscures the facts.

options.label: Memory quilt atlas
options.thesis: Blocks of worn cloth, each with its owner and date.
options.risk: Needs real family stories the shop doesn't have yet.
options.case: Loses on both axes, and it would need invented heirloom stories, which are off-limits.
options.kept: Fact labels stitched to each piece.

options.label: Seven-segment display
options.lineage: LED clocks, price totems and scoreboards
options.thesis: One segment mask for every number; unlit cells drawn too.
options.risk: Cold and mechanical for bridal jewellery.
options.case: Loses on both axes as a whole world, but the rate board idea transfers to the rate cell.
options.kept: Fixed digit cells that flip only when the rate changes.

options.label: CRT arcade pixel glow
options.risk: Games say nothing about gold or trust.

options.label: Wax-pack trading card
options.risk: Collectible sports cards feel off for family gold.
options.case: Loses on both axes, but flipping a piece to see its facts is useful.
options.kept: Flip a piece to see its facts.

options.label: Game Boy four-shade field
options.thesis: Exactly four greens and an 8×8 tile grid.
options.risk: Nostalgic novelty, unrelated to the shop.

canonCard.label: The category standard (your shortlist)
canonCard.thesis: A modern luxury jeweller site at full craft: white space, an editorial serif, full-bleed bridal photography and a trust strip carrying the hallmark, rate and hours.
canonCard.viewport: A split hero: the headline and Visit / WhatsApp buttons on white, a bride's hands with gold bangles on the right, and a trust strip at the bottom.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other jewellers by design.
